paragraphs.text: Bassorah is a city on Rabiah the Infinite . It contains the famed Bazaar of Bassorah , the second-largest in Rabiah, and its Mosque Quarter .

There is a Bassorah in almost all of the 1001 planes of Rabiah. It boasts a tremendous variety of inhabitants, among which are Bird Maidens , Desert Nomads and Gypsies. Here the Bird Maiden Fyrah and the Nomad Pakhit battled the Eater of the Infinite , a Serendib Efreet whose heart was so cold that he tried to destroy all other living beings on Rabiah.
The Mosque Quarter of Bassorah was where the Sorceress Queen Nailah fought against the Nomad Taysir , Dervish Taysir , and Raghib .
Bassorah is the ancient name of Basra in Iraq.
